## What this file checks

Rendering this document to PDF exercises the whole toolchain in one step.
Quarto has to find this project's Python, start a Jupyter kernel in it, run the
code below, and hand the result to LaTeX.

If you get a PDF, all of those pieces work.

## Python and pandas

```{python}
import sys
import pandas as pd

print(sys.version)
print("pandas", pd.__version__)
```

```{python}
pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "course": ["DSCI 511", "DSCI 521", "DSCI 523"],
        "block": [1, 1, 2],
        "language": ["Python", "Python", "R"],
    }
)
```

## Characters that are not plain English

Assignments regularly contain accents, Greek letters, degree signs and proper
dashes. If the line below appears correctly in the PDF, your LaTeX installation
can typeset them:

Montréal · naïve · Öl · 5 °C · α β γ · 10 – 20 · "curly quotes"
